about: Quiz Island (Henry, Nov 18): Race Board's quiz on Reading Island's map. Questions come from Race Board's bank (games/race-board/content.json), Quiz Battle's sets (via kru-quiz.js) or the unit picked on the setup screen. Intro slides only; no questions live here.

intro.title: Quiz Island
text: One team at a time answers a question.
Get it right and claim an island!

example.label: Example
example.result: Right answer: tap an island on the map

intro.title: Harder = more points
text: the island you win is worth the same.

intro.title: Secret islands
text: Some islands hide a secret. You find out when you claim one!
Careful: not every secret is good.

intro.title: ⚔ Steal an island
text: Hard and Impossible answers can steal an island.
When the map is full, every right answer steals!

intro.title: Power-ups
text: Use each power-up once per game.
Risk it: win double, or lose points!

intro.title: Final Wager
text: Near the end: one question for every team. Bet any points!
